title: Oxathiapiprolin shows strong activity against Phytophthora infestans
abstract: Oxathiapiprolin inhibited mycelial growth of Phytophthora infestans in vitro with low EC50 values. The compound also reduced zoospore germination in detached leaf assays.

title: Consumer acceptance of genetically modified potatoes resistant to late blight
abstract: Late blight caused by Phytophthora infestans is a major constraint in potato production. This study investigated consumer willingness to pay for resistant potato varieties and did not test fungicidal compounds.

title: Lauric acid and glycerol monolaurate suppress Phytophthora sojae
abstract: Lauric acid and glycerol monolaurate showed inhibitory activity against Phytophthora sojae. The treatments reduced zoospore germination and mycelial growth in concentration-dependent assays.

title: Development of PCR primers for detection of Phytophthora species infecting potatoes
abstract: This work developed internal transcribed spacer primers for detection of Phytophthora infestans and related species in potato samples. No compound activity assay was performed.

title: Sensitivity of Phytophthora porri to metalaxyl
abstract: The study measured sensitivity profiles of Phytophthora porri isolates to metalaxyl and reported variation among populations.
